findings.title: Orange team's table runs off the right edge on phone
findings.detail: On a 390 px screen the two team tables stay side by side. The Orange header is cut to 'ORANG', and its K, D and Ping columns sit at x 359-393+ past the panel edge (about 357 px), so Orange's kills, deaths and ping cannot be read. Half the scoreboard is missing on phone.
findings.evidence: scoreboard@phone.png: 'ORANG' clipped at the panel edge, no K/D/PING headers or values for Onyx, Pike, Comet, Vandal; DOM: 'K' at x359, 'D' at x384 (p50 contrast 1.06 because they're drawn over the world outside the panel).
findings.fix: Under ~600 px, stack the two team tables vertically (Blue, then Orange) inside one scrolling panel, or drop Ping and narrow the name column so both tables fit within the 16 px gutters.

findings.title: Loadout prompt draws on top of the scoreboard
findings.detail: The 'Team deathmatch · change your loadout now' prompt and its countdown stay layered above the Tab scoreboard. On phone the prompt runs straight across the Blue and Orange headers ('TEA', 'NOW' stick out at the sides) and the countdown digit shows through the Blue header. On desktop it ghosts through the 'You' row at y 296. Text on top of text fails any contrast measure and makes the team names hard to read.
findings.evidence: scoreboard@phone.png at y~225 css: prompt letters over 'BLUE 0' and 'ORANG'; scoreboard@desktop.png: faint 'TEAM DEATHMATCH · CHANGE YOUR LOADOUT NOW' behind row 1 of both tables.
findings.fix: Put the scoreboard above the centre-prompt layer (z-index), or hide the countdown prompt while Tab is held.

findings.title: Score strip labels and the Health label vanish over the world
findings.detail: The score strip's labels ('◆ Blue · you', 'TDM · 75', '▲ Orange') are 11 px --ds-text-3 on a translucent plate, and measure 1.97-2.91:1 at p10. 'Health' is --ds-text-2 at 13 px with only a shadow, and measures 1.08:1 at p10 over the bright grass. DESIGN.md also says --ds-text-3 is for labels on solid panels only, never over the map.
findings.evidence: contrast.md match-hud@desktop: '◆ Blue · you' p10 1.97 fail, '▲ Orange' 2.67 fail, 'TDM · 75' 2.91 fail, 'Health' p10 1.08; the screenshot shows 'Health' as a barely visible smudge at 51,975.
findings.fix: Make the score strip's plate an opaque --ds-panel, or move its labels to --ds-text-2. Give the health/ammo corners the bottom-edge --ds-scrim gradient that DESIGN.md allows.

findings.title: Scoreboard headers at 11 px and BOT tags at 9 px
findings.detail: Column headers (#, Player, K, D, Ping) are 11 px and the BOT tags are 9 px, both under the 12 px floor. The weapon's fire mode 'auto' is 10 px on every in-play screen, and the score strip labels are 11 px. DESIGN.md's smallest step is 13 px (--ds-type-small). The bordered BOT tag is also the badge style DESIGN.md rules out.
findings.evidence: contrast.md scoreboard@desktop: 21 size fails, 'BOT' 9 px bold, 'Ping'/'K'/'D'/'Player' 11 px; 'auto' 10 px at 1852,973.
findings.fix: Use --ds-type-small (13 px) for table headers, the fire mode and the strip labels. Replace the BOT tag with 13 px --ds-text-2 role text under the name ('Bot'), the way lobby seats show their role.

findings.title: Twelve font sizes on one screen instead of five
findings.detail: Scoreboard plus HUD use 9, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, 20, 22, 28, 30, 48 and 54 px, with many neighbours 1-2 px apart (9/10/11, 13/15/17, 20/22, 28/30). DESIGN.md fixes five steps: 13 / 16 / 22 / 32-52 / 30-60. Row text at 15 px, team names at 17 px and the title at 20 px are all off-scale.
findings.fix: Map everything onto the five --ds-type-* variables: headers/tags 13, rows 16, team names and the board title 22 (heading), team totals and the clock at heading or display size.

findings.title: Ammo, health, clock and scores use proportional digits
findings.detail: No numeric element has tabular figures: the 54 px magazine count, 48 px health, the 10:00 clock, team scores and the scoreboard's K/D. The magazine and clock count every frame or second, so with proportional digits they jitter sideways. DESIGN.md requires tabular-nums.
findings.evidence: match-hud@desktop.dom.json: tabular:false on 'mag' 30, 'hp' 100, 'clock' 10:00 and 'score' 0; the same holds in every DOM sample.
findings.fix: Add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to .mag, .hp, .clock, .score, .total and the scoreboard's td cells, or set it once on the HUD root.

findings.title: 41-character prompt set in tracked caps
findings.detail: 'TEAM DEATHMATCH · CHANGE YOUR LOADOUT NOW' is a sentence set in bold uppercase with wide tracking. It breaks TYP-04 (uppercase runs over ~30 characters) and DESIGN.md, which keeps tracked caps for controls only and puts running text in sentence case. On phone it fills the full 390 px width edge to edge (x 1-389).
findings.evidence: DOM: div.sub 'Team deathmatch · change your loadout now', upper:true, 13 px bold; match-hud@phone box [1,220,388,13].
findings.fix: Sentence case, regular weight, 16 px body: 'Team deathmatch. Change your loadout now', with the key hint as a .ds-kbd cap. Wrap it inside the gutters on phone.

findings.title: Health and ammo blocks sit 32 px from the screen edges
findings.detail: Health starts at x 32 and the ammo block ends at x 1888, both 32 px from the edge. That is inside the 3% safe area (58 px) and the 56 px --ds-gutter that the pause menu uses. On phone the score strip's top is at y~24 (under the 47 px notch inset) and the health and ammo bars sit at y~818 (inside the 34 px home-bar inset).
findings.evidence: DOM 'hp' box [32,993,68,48], 'res' right edge 1888; match-hud@phone.png: the score strip's top border at 48 device px, the bars at 1636 device px.
findings.fix: Anchor the HUD corners to max(var(--ds-gutter), env(safe-area-inset-*)) so they share the menus' 56 / 16 px frame and add the phone safe-area insets.

findings.title: Mint signal used for decoration and status
findings.detail: DESIGN.md keeps --ds-signal for things that can be acted on or the one selected choice. Here it is the scoreboard's top rule (decoration), the 'You' row's left bar (DESIGN.md says your own seat uses a bar in text colour), the Health cross (status), and the mint chevrons stuck at the screen edges (top-left at 32,55; bottom at 32,955 and 273,955; right edge on phone), none of which can be pressed. With signal on all of these, it no longer reads as 'this is clickable' in the pause menu.
findings.evidence: scoreboard@desktop.png: mint line across the panel top at y 142, mint bar on row 'You'; match-hud@desktop.png: mint chevrons at the screen edges and a mint '+' before Health.
findings.fix: Scoreboard top rule: none, or --ds-line. 'You' row: a raised step with a --ds-text bar. Health cross: --ds-text-2. Give the edge chevrons their own meaning and colour (alert for threat direction), or remove them if they are leftovers.

findings.title: Empty 200x250 stats panel covers the range lane
findings.detail: The Practice Range stats panel has four rows of text (TTK, distance, shots/hits, last hit), then about 160 px of empty dark box under them. On phone it covers the lower-left third of the play view, including the lane floor, and carries no information. DESIGN.md: 'If an element carries no information and no action, it goes.' The same empty box shows on desktop at 24,720.
findings.evidence: range-hud@phone.png: dark panel from 48,968 to 460,1462 device px, with text only in the top 150 device px.
findings.fix: Size the panel to its rows (or collapse the empty history area until there are hits to list), and on phone dock it as a single readout strip under the score area.

findings.title: Pause title, HUD strip and countdown overlap on phone
findings.detail: Under the pause scrim the live HUD keeps drawing. 'PAUSED' sits on top of the score strip's '0' and '10:00', the 'TEAM DEATHMATCH · CHANGE YOUR LOADOUT NOW' prompt and countdown '2' run through the Loadout and Settings rows, and the faded health and ammo show through the controls list. The controls list is also cut off at the bottom: Tab and Esc are missing and nothing shows it scrolls. On desktop the key-hint footer sits on top of the health readout ('100' visible behind the MOVE hint).
findings.evidence: pause@phone.png: 'PAUSED' over the score strip at top, the prompt over 'LOADOUT' at y~225 css, '2' behind 'SETTINGS'; pause@desktop.png: footer hints overlapping the '100' at 32,993.
findings.fix: Hide the HUD layer (score strip, centre prompt, health/ammo) while the pause page is open. Make the page body scroll inside the .ds-page shell with the footer pinned.

findings.title: Goal is never stated; 'TDM · 75' is unexplained
findings.detail: Match start says 'Team deathmatch · change your loadout now' but never says what wins: that the first team to 75 kills wins. That target only shows as 'TDM · 75' in 11 px text, and neither the abbreviation nor the number is explained on the HUD or the scoreboard (ONB-03). The range's first spawn has no control hints at all (ONB-01): no 'Esc for controls', no move or fire hint.
findings.evidence: match-hud@desktop.png top strip 'TDM · 75'; centre prompt has no objective; range-hud@desktop.png shows no key hints anywhere.
findings.fix: Countdown line: 'First team to 75 kills wins'. Scoreboard title: 'Team deathmatch · first to 75'. Show a short 'Esc: controls' hint on first spawn in the range and fade it after the first shot.
